roles_name_present.name: roles_name_present
roles_name_present.value: "app"."roles"."name_en" is not null or "app"."roles"."name_ar" is not null

user_role_assignments_scope_consistent.name: user_role_assignments_scope_consistent
user_role_assignments_scope_consistent.value:
("app"."user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'organization' and "app"."user_role_assignments"."department_id" is null and "app"."user_role_assignments"."team_id" is null)
       or ("app"."user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'department' and "app"."user_role_assignments"."department_id" is not null and "app"."user_role_assignments"."team_id" is null)
       or ("app"."user_role_assignments"."scope_type" = 'team' and "app"."user_role_assignments"."team_id" is not null and "app"."user_role_assignments"."department_id" is null)

finance_entries_player_needs_team.name: finance_entries_player_needs_team
finance_entries_player_needs_team.value: "app"."finance_entries"."roster_member_id" is null or "app"."finance_entries"."team_id" is not null

finance_entries_kind_fields.name: finance_entries_kind_fields
finance_entries_kind_fields.value:
("app"."finance_entries"."kind" = 'expense' and "app"."finance_entries"."realized" and "app"."finance_entries"."certainty" is null)
       or ("app"."finance_entries"."kind" = 'revenue' and "app"."finance_entries"."certainty" is not null and "app"."finance_entries"."ownership" is null)

contract_signers_signed_record.name: contract_signers_signed_record
contract_signers_signed_record.value: "app"."contract_signers"."status" <> 'signed' or ("app"."contract_signers"."signed_at" is not null and "app"."contract_signers"."signature_method" is not null and "app"."contract_signers"."consent_text" is not null and "app"."contract_signers"."document_sha256" is not null and "app"."contract_signers"."verified_at" is not null and "app"."contract_signers"."record_sha256" is not null)

contracts_roster_needs_team.name: contracts_roster_needs_team
contracts_roster_needs_team.value: "app"."contracts"."roster_member_id" is null or "app"."contracts"."team_id" is not null

signing_rounds_completed_document.name: signing_rounds_completed_document
signing_rounds_completed_document.value: "app"."signing_rounds"."status" <> 'completed' or ("app"."signing_rounds"."signed_document_file_id" is not null and "app"."signing_rounds"."completed_at" is not null)

meetings_administrative_org_wide.name: meetings_administrative_org_wide
meetings_administrative_org_wide.value: "app"."meetings"."kind" <> 'administrative' or ("app"."meetings"."team_id" is null and "app"."meetings"."department_id" is null)
